chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Dawud ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) addressed the people and said: 'Shall I inform you of the most evil of you?' They said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'The one who withholds his gifts, strikes his slave, and provisions himself alone.' So they thought that Allah had not created a creature more evil than this.

Then he said: 'Shall I inform you of the one who is more evil than that?' They said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'The one whose goodness is not hoped for, nor is there safety from his evil.' So they thought that Allah had not created a creature more evil than this.

Then he said: 'Shall I inform you of the one who is more evil than that?' They said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'The foul-mouthed, cursing one, who when the believers are mentioned in his presence, he curses them, and when they mention him, they curse him.'

key_terms.لَا يُؤْمَنُ شَرُّهُ: nor is there safety from his evil
key_terms.لَا يُرْجَى خَيْرُهُ: whose goodness is not hoped for

ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics of the most evil people according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines a hierarchy of moral decay, culminating in the 'mutafahhish' (the excessively foul-mouthed), whose defining trait is the mutual cursing with the faithful, reflecting the Shia emphasis on social cohesion and the sanctity of the believers' community. The progression from material stinginess to spiritual unpredictability, and finally to vocal hostility, illustrates how internal character flaws manifest as external disruptions to the communal bond. This specific description of the 'mutafahhish' is often cited by scholars to define the characteristics of those who alienate themselves from the divine community through persistent verbal abuse.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Dawood Bin Al Nu’man, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> addressed the people, so he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Shall I<sup>saww</sup> inform you of the most evil of you all?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rssool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! The one who prevents his gifts, and strikes his slave, and provides from himself alone. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not Create a creature who is more evil than this’.

Then he<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘Shall I<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> inform you of the one who is more evil than that?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>! He<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘The one whose goodness is not hoped for nor is there a safety from his evil’. So they thought that Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> has not Created a creature who is more evil than this.

Then heasws said: ‘Shall Isaww infrom you of the one who is more evil than that?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allahsaww! Hesaww said: ‘He is a foulmouth, profane person. The one who, when the Momineen are mentioned in his presence, he curses them, and when they mention him, (they) condemn him’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ali ibn Asbat from Dawud b al-Nu’man from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Once the Messenger of Allah addressed the people and asked, ‘Should I tell you about the wicked ones among you?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Messenger of Allah, please do so.’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘They are those of you who refuse to make any gifts (to anyone), beat up their slaves and supplies just his own self. ’ They thought that Allah has not created any creature most wicked than such person. “

Then the Messenger of Allah said, ‘Should I tell who is most wicked than he?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Messenger of Allah, please do so.’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘Most wicked than he is one from whom no good can be expected and from whose evil people do not feel safe.’ They thought that Allah has not created anyone most wicked than he. “

The Messenger of Allah then said, ‘Should I tell who is most wicked than he?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Messenger of Allah, please do so.’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘He is a foulmouthed, profane person. When believers are mentioned before him, he abuses them and, when he is mentioned before the believers, they condemn him.’”
